snippet.title: NEDRA | Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
A frozen nightmare begins June 23.
Wishlist NEDRA now on Steam ➤https://bit.ly/NEDRA

When an SOS signal echoes across Antarctica,  mechanic Artur is thrust into a frozen hell where warmth might be deadlier than the cold. In NEDRA, a first-person survival horror game, players must navigate a blizzard-choked wasteland, stalked by things drawn to heat—things that should not exist.

🧊 Use cold as cover—enemies hunt by thermal signature
🧬 Explore a haunting Soviet research base 
🧠 A psychological descent inspired by Solaris, Poe, and The Thing

Published in collaboration with indie.io
Follow indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q

#SurvivalHorror #Lovecraftian #FirstPersonHorror #StealthGame #IndieHorror #SteamGames #Horror #indiegames
